title: Canonical finite-level pullback through the local base change
statement: Let f:X→Y be a scheme morphism, y∈Y, F an O_X-module and p,n≥0. Put X′=Spec O_y×_Y X with projection g′, and X_n=Spec(O_y/m_y^(n+1))×_Y X with projection i_n [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-pbc-formal-fibre-cohomology]. Define i′_n:X_n→X′ by pullback.lift from its projection to Spec O_y and i_n; thus i′_n followed by g′ equals i_n. Write F′=g′*F and F_n=i_n*F [def-pc-module-pullback]. Define the h-map F′→i′_(n*)F_n to be the adjoint, under the tensor-pullback adjunction of g′ pinned by its sectionwise unit [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], of the unit F→i_(n*)F_n followed by the projection-equality and pushforward-composition identifications. Define formalFunctionsFinitePullback to be the additive cohomology map of this h-map [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap], from formalFunctionsLocalCohomology [def-weil-pbc-formal-functions-local-comparison] to formalFibreCohomologyLocal [def-weil-pbc-formal-fibre-cohomology].
